correctness.rationale: Rows are exactly inner-action orbits; operation preservation forces all automorphisms into one additive-linear slope with arbitrary row translations. Labeled-fiber closure and normal-shear orbit quotient are bijective. The remaining affine action is counted by size-weighted twisted Burnside on translation-subset classes and cycle factorization. The field-general result is a deductive proof, not inferred from tests. Exact independent checks enumerate all operation-preserving permutations on 4 and 9 points, actual closure on 4,9,16 points, and all ambient subquandle orbits by two methods on 16 and 81 points.

value.rationale: It determines a complete natural symmetry invariant of all embedded subquandles of one canonical infinite family for any prime and extension degree, not merely a narrow arithmetic slice. It shows concrete large symmetry collapses (119 to 9, 10933 to 39), yields a prime-field closed formula and sharp infinite-prime asymptotic, and gives a quotient computation over much smaller affine label spaces, useful for moduli and comparative subquandle geometry.
